title: Condensate food chain with chi=0 and k0=0.002: predator droplets persist to t=8000 and prey/predator populations cycle with a lag (128^2, seed 0)
summary: In c36's closed condensate food chain, removing the prey-predator repulsion (chi 0.3 -> 0) and doubling the uncatalysed fuel->prey term (k0 0.002) turns the one-epidemic outcome into a standing predator population (25-45 predator droplets, many ring-shaped around prey they are eating) and repeated prey cycles: prey droplets fall to 0 three times and renucleate from fuel, and predator mass peaks ~500 t after each prey peak (cycles_s0_128.png). In a 4-arm screen (base, Ksat 0.1 with k2 1, Mb 0.003, interference Bint 0.1) and chi -0.3/0 without k0 change, predators died by t=1500-2600 at 128^2; with k0 0.003 they also persist but take only 18-19% of their intake from prey droplets (the rest from dissolved prey), against 41% at k0 0.002 (eat_droplet / eat_dilute in c0k2.json, droplet = ca>0.5 dilated 2 px). Seeds, a 256^2 check and the predator-free twin are running.
